purpose: Style-selection mockups only; no application implementation change

concepts.name: 白蓝原生
concepts.style: STYLE A: Quiet Windows Fluent-inspired light UI. White and cool very light gray surfaces, restrained azure blue accent #2563EB, a very subtle frosted title area, thin neutral separators and soft 10px rounded cards. Clean uncluttered system typography. Almost-white background, extremely restrained blue ambience behind the window. Calm professional accessibility and clarity. Recommendation card mostly white with a fine blue accent and pale blue tile well. Elegant real desktop app, not generic webpage.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE beautiful, polished, high-fidelity desktop UI concept image for a Chinese Mahjong screenshot advice companion called "Majan". New design, not editing the game. Portrait composition, one full app window about 560 by 900 logical pixels centered in the canvas with a small quiet margin, front-on crisp screenshot style. No device frame.
Input image 1 is ONLY supporting content to insert in the small screenshot preview area inside the app; preserve its blue Mahjong table appearance. Do not fill the canvas with the game.
Layout: quiet slim title bar "Majan 雀魂助手". A compact connection area with a game-window select "雀魂麻将", resolution select "1920×1080" and small green status "已连接". Exactly FOUR action buttons, elegantly spaced in a 2 by 2 arrangement or one restrained toolbar: "刷新雀魂窗口", "整理窗口", "开始自动建议", "刷新截图". Make "开始自动建议" the only prominent primary button. No extra feature buttons.
Main feature: a beautiful prominent recommendation card, label "当前建议", large text "打出六万", a carefully drawn ivory Mahjong six-character tile with 六 above red 萬 as a supporting visual. Small status "识别完成". Below it a crisp candidate list headed "候选操作 · Top 5", column header "相对评分". Exactly 5 rows in this order: "六万" "82.6%"; "二筒" "9.3%"; "三筒" "4.8%"; "四筒" "2.1%"; "八索" "1.2%". Rank 1 is tastefully highlighted. Subtle horizontal strength bars are welcome. These are relative scores, NEVER label as win rate. Lower area has a small wide screenshot thumbnail labeled "当前截图", using input image. Footer may have a tiny "示例数据".
Use professional legible Simplified Chinese typography and realistic UI spacing. Thoughtful hierarchy, precise alignment, rounded corners. Every main element visible without scrolling. Design should look buildable, refined, personal desktop tool. No sidebar, no charts, no account/profile, no extra navigation, no ads, no giant marketing headline, no watermark, no additional buttons.
STYLE A: Quiet Windows Fluent-inspired light UI. White and cool very light gray surfaces, restrained azure blue accent #2563EB, a very subtle frosted title area, thin neutral separators and soft 10px rounded cards. Clean uncluttered system typography. Almost-white background, extremely restrained blue ambience behind the window. Calm professional accessibility and clarity. Recommendation card mostly white with a fine blue accent and pale blue tile well. Elegant real desktop app, not generic webpage.

concepts.name: 石墨深色
concepts.style: STYLE B: Premium Linear/Raycast-inspired dark professional utility. Deep graphite #14171C background, layered charcoal #1E232B cards, luminous but restrained mint/teal #63DBBA primary accent. Sharp high-contrast pale text, muted cool secondary text, hairline borders, small precise icons, beautifully compact typography. Subtle mint highlight on top recommendation and first candidate, other rows understated. Background behind app is dark charcoal. No noisy glow, no excessive gradients; polished focused tool for use next to a game.

concepts.name: 米白和风
concepts.style: STYLE C: Refined modern Japanese-inspired Mahjong companion. Warm ivory #F6F2E9 background, forest green #275A45 accent, near-black warm typography, very subtle champagne gold details. Quiet matte ivory cards, generous breathing room, restrained fine borders. Recommendation title can have an elegant Chinese serif treatment, controls and data remain highly legible modern sans-serif. A tasteful small geometric tile-inspired mark. No floral decorations, no big paintings, no wood panels, no ornamental clutter. Elegant warm calm desktop interface.

concepts.name: 蓝紫轻透
concepts.style: STYLE D: Contemporary restrained glass desktop companion. A soft blue-lavender ambient background around window, translucent pearly blue-gray panels, crisp dark indigo text with accessible contrast, blue-violet #6963E8 primary action, subtle luminous edges. Frosted glass effect understated and buildable, refined rounded 16px cards, sophisticated very soft shadows. Recommendation card with a soft lavender wash and a porcelain Mahjong tile. Playful but clean and premium, no neon cyberpunk, no giant glow, no decorative spheres.
